prompt:
Premium handmade cut-paper collage: layered construction paper, cardstock and cozy felt with visible fiber texture, softly rounded scissor-cut edges, slight handmade imperfections, tiny stitched details, real button holes and twisted yarn fibers, and soft tactile shadows between stacked layers. Saturated coral, marigold, teal, leaf green, plum and sky blue on warm cream. Child-safe preschool proportions, handmade warmth. No vector art, no glossy plastic, no text unless the prompt explicitly requests the title.

A precise four-column by two-row handmade papercraft asset sheet on one perfectly flat uniform dark-charcoal background. Exactly eight separate cut-paper pieces, one centered inside each equal invisible cell with generous charcoal margin and no overlap. Reading order: coral paper circle; marigold paper circle; teal paper triangle; plum five-point paper star; pink paper heart; cream scalloped paper cloud; sky-blue fringed paper rectangle; one gently curved strip made from narrow coral, gold, green, blue and plum paper bands side by side. Visible cardstock fibers, softly imperfect scissor-cut edges, small tactile shadow contained inside each cell. No cell borders, labels, text, letters, hands, duplicates, or extra objects.
